title: bidens alba var. radiata
intro: Bidens alba var. radiata, commonly known as the white beggartick, is a flowering plant species in the aster family, characterized by its white, rayless flower heads and hairy leaves. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Bidens alba var. radiata include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which can contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating diseases and promoting overall health.
